Ооооочень недооцененная игра, маленький онлайн и это очень плохо. Игра очень хорошая, всем рекомендую. Но цена всё же завышенная.

Basically, it’s Tetris with physics, and even though I’m recommending this game, I did get bored within' 15 minutes of playing.

I think the asking price is a little bit too much for the amount of content you’re going to get. If it was $10, I would say it’s perfect, which is why I recommend picking it up on sale.

This game does do so many things right. The UI, music, and sound effects have so much love, and you can just tell the devs put a lot of time and energy into making a game they care about.

I also think it’s good that the game challenges your brain with different levels, challenges, and little puzzles, but that alone wasn’t enough to keep me engaged. It would have been cool if you could customize your character, unlock cosmetics, or maybe unlock more magical abilities that you slowly get to use as you keep playing. I think it just needed a little bit more of a system beyond going through levels and trying to beat them. Without something like that, it’s hard for me to say this feels worth the $20 asking price. 

All that being said, this very much is a couch co-op party game. The real issue is remembering that you even own it when you want to utilize it. I forgot this game was even in my Steam library, and after playing alone, I got incredibly bored.

When I brought one of my friends in, I had a lot more fun, but even with the challenges, game modes, magic, and physics, I felt pretty much done after about 30ish minutes.

Ultimately, I do recommend it, as long as you know what you’re getting yourself into! 😊

Si tienes con quien o quienes jugar (maximo 4 jugadores por lobby), te recomiendo comprarlo, ademas que no consume muchos recursos y le puedes bajar la calidad grafica que al final ni se nota.

Ya si vas por los logros tienes que jugar los retos, son 50 y despues del 30 aprox aumenta bastante la dificultad siendo los ultimos 10 horribles y te van a hacer ragear, pero cuando lo logras te siente liberado.
